SiteHeader.query: query SiteHeader($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { BrandName: field(name: "BrandName") { jsonValue } Logo: field(name: "Logo") { jsonValue } HomeLink: field(name: "HomeLink") { jsonValue } SearchAction: field(name: "SearchAction") { jsonValue } SearchLabel: field(name: "SearchLabel") { jsonValue } SearchQueryName: field(name: "SearchQueryName") { jsonValue } children { results { id Title: field(name: "Title") { jsonValue } Link: field(name: "Link") { jsonValue } Group: field(name: "Group") { jsonValue } Logo: field(name: "Logo") { jsonValue } } } } }

CardGrid.query: query CardGrid($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { Heading: field(name: "Heading") { jsonValue } Intro: field(name: "Intro") { jsonValue } children { results { id Title: field(name: "Title") { jsonValue } Summary: field(name: "Summary") { jsonValue } Image: field(name: "Image") { jsonValue } Link: field(name: "Link") { jsonValue } } } } }

CallToAction.query: query CallToAction($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { Title: field(name: "Title") { jsonValue } Body: field(name: "Body") { jsonValue } Link: field(name: "Link") { jsonValue } Image: field(name: "Image") { jsonValue } } }

Breadcrumb.query: query Breadcrumb($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { Fields: fields(ownFields: true) { name jsonValue } children(first: 10) { results { id Fields: fields(ownFields: true) { name jsonValue } } } } }

PageIntro.query: query PageIntro($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { Fields: fields(ownFields: true) { name jsonValue } } }

ResourceList.query: query ResourceList($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { Fields: fields(ownFields: true) { name jsonValue } children(first: 30) { results { id Fields: fields(ownFields: true) { name jsonValue } } } } }

RichTextSection.query: query RichTextSection($datasource: String!, $language: String!) { datasource: item(path: $datasource, language: $language) { Fields: fields(ownFields: true) { name jsonValue } } }
